title: Whispering Whelk Wizard
statement: A pearly, spiral-shelled sea snail the size of a teacup, who tiptoes along a mossy driftwood arch and hums soft, bubbling spells to the glowing anemones below. Each hum releases a trail of tiny silver bubbles that drift upward like lanterns, while the water shifts from twilight teal to warm amber around its small, patient, slightly magical life.
